agent: Fresh independent ChatGPT Work agents; inherited runtime model with no override. Exact model build ID was not exposed.
method: Prepared six fresh isolated checkouts; supplied only the skill path, repository path, user task, no-commit instruction and external report path. Expected outcomes withheld. Graded working-tree and index contents against fixture state; parent reviewed diffs and reports for meaning.
review: Independent code review reproduced staged-only grader evasion and custom-length merge markers. Both were fixed, regression-tested, and independently rechecked. Final deterministic suite: 46 tests.
iteration: An earlier six-case run made the expected guidance decisions; a test bytecode file later appeared in one checkout despite its clean-status report. The cause was not established. That run was not used as final evidence. After the review fixes, all six cases were prepared again and run with fresh agents; final results follow.
limitations: One final run per case on controlled small repositories. Not a cross-model or large-monorepo benchmark. Structural verification alone does not validate instruction meaning. Older recorded evaluation results describe their earlier skill snapshot.
